description: Compare 2 to 4 portfolios (built-in model portfolios, canonical strategies or your own allocations) side by side over their COMMON window, which is the only fair comparison: two pages' headline numbers usually cover different periods (a portfolio holding gold starts in 2004, the Ivy portfolio in 1996). Returns CAGR, volatility, max drawdown, Sharpe, Sortino, Ulcer index, best/worst year and longest time underwater on the aligned months, each portfolio's own full-window figures (labelled with their start), the pairwise correlation of their monthly returns and a calendar-year table. Use it for 'All Weather vs Golden Butterfly vs 60/40', 'which of these held up better', 'my portfolio vs 60/40'. Each item in `portfolios` has exactly one of `template` or `strategy` (ids from list_portfolios) or `assets` (your own allocation, including nested portfolios, rotations and strategies as holdings, with optional `rebalance` and `overlay`), plus an optional `label`. Ids are precomputed from the monthly refresh; `assets` entries are computed live (at most 2 custom entries and 24 distinct tickers per call). Read-only. For one portfolio's detail use analyze_portfolio, portfolio_returns or portfolio_risk.

assets.description: Your own allocation instead of an id, computed live. Same format as analyze_portfolio's `assets` (plain tickers, or nested portfolios, rotations and strategies via `sleeve`).

sleeve.description: Advanced: a strategy node instead of a plain ticker — the app's SleeveRef, resolved server-side. Supported: a rotation/selection (`{source:'selection', config:{universe:[{ticker}], signal:{kind:'indicator', indicatorId, params} | {kind:'trailing-return', lookbackMonths, skipMonths (>= 1; the ranking for a month only sees data through the previous month-end)}, topK, weighting, rebalance}, label}`), a strategy-over-node (`{source:'strategy-over', child:{ticker}, config:<BacktestConfig>, label}`), a saved strategy preset (`{source:'backtest-live', ticker, frequency, config, presetId, label}`), a curated public-library strategy (`{source:'backtest-public', strategyId, label}`), a published backtest share (`{source:'backtest-share', shareId, label}`), a gallery template (`{source:'portfolio-public', templateId, label}`), or a nested portfolio (`{source:'portfolio-mine', portfolioId, config, label}`). Strategies with a config get a node-level overfit check (a share carries only its frozen curve, so no overfit).

ticker.description: Yahoo Finance ticker, e.g. VTI, BND, GLD. Omit when `sleeve` is given.

label.description: Optional display name for this column.

overlay.description: Optional portfolio-level trend-filter overlay applied to the WHOLE book: hold the entire portfolio only while its own level is above its N-month moving average, otherwise cash. Composition is monthly (a 10-month filter ≈ the classic 200-day one).

rebalance.description: Rebalancing cadence for custom portfolios (templates use their own).

template.description: Built-in model portfolio id (list_portfolios shows all 19).

years.description: Calendar-year rows to include (most recent N years of the common window; 0 = none). Default 10.

name: compare_portfolios
